title: Glitch cut
description: Scene change through jittering horizontal slices (slices is clamped to 2-24); use for tech, gaming or error-themed cuts.
props: {from: ReactNode; to: ReactNode; startFrame?: number /*0*/; durationInFrames?: number /*14*/; slices?: number /*8*/; intensity?: number /*90*/; seed?: string /*'glitch'*/}
example:
import {GlitchCut} from './blocks/glitch-cut/GlitchCut.tsx';
<GlitchCut from={<SceneA />} to={<SceneB />} startFrame={40} slices={8} intensity={90} />
